subject: literacy
concept: Writing a short research report from a research question through organized notes to a final written piece
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student uses a research organizer to plan question, notes, and citations before writing
exercise.abstract: Student writes a short research report combining a question, paraphrased notes, organization, and at least one citation

assessment.mastery_threshold: report includes a clear question, organized paraphrased content, and at least one proper citation
misconception_flags: report answers a different question than the one originally posed

interest_binding: topic generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
